observations.body: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: John appears preaching and the prophet’s wilderness voice is cited.
observations.label: A preacher and a quoted voice

observations.body: John’s wilderness location, proclamation, Isaiah quotation, and gathering crowds shape one opening scene.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Matthew 3:1–5 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The quoted voice frames John while Matthew’s narrative adds its own people and actions.
payload.title: A voice in Judea’s wilderness
